description: The "tchiks guitars" channel features a self-taught woodworker building electric guitars from scratch, often with a strong focus on unconventional or repurposed materials. The videos document the full woodworking and assembly process, most famously showcasing a functional guitar constructed almost entirely from IKEA furniture parts. Beyond the viral IKEA builds, the channel also covers more traditional guitar-building projects, such as crafting a guitar from a single block of cherry wood or building a bass for his daughter.
